verdict.rationale: Oneleet documents a few narrow batch actions. 'Publish draft policies' publishes all eligible drafts at once, a secure device baseline applies org-wide in one click, and removing a framework cascades to its unused controls. An MCP server and scoped service keys also let agents and scripts automate workspace actions. However, nothing shows general multi-select or bulk editing (e.g., bulk assign, triage or resolve findings or controls), and there is no bulk API, so AI-driven bulk work is only implied. Missing for 10: general bulk-edit/multi-select across item types, documented bulk endpoints or MCP batch tools, a published API spec (OpenAPI probes returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration.
